data.title: 墨染希 · 神社石阶上的初夏夜风
data.action: 赤足坐在神社长长的石阶最高处，双手撑在身后石板上，淡茶色短发被夜风吹拂，抬头望着满天繁星，侧过脸对你露出邻家青梅竹马般毫无防备的温柔微笑。
data.location: 小镇后山墨染神社鸟居下，俯瞰山脚下万家灯火与星河长明
data.timeOfDay: 初夏蝉鸣刚歇的清凉午夜
data.lighting: 红色鸟居旁常夜石灯笼的暖红火光，将少女白皙的双腿与侧脸笼罩在古朴温存的光影中
data.mood: 青梅竹马纯真温暖的陪伴感，夏夜微风般的清爽自然与怦然心动
data.description: 小镇后山墨染神社鸟居下，俯瞰山脚下万家灯火与星河长明。赤足坐在神社长长的石阶最高处，双手撑在身后石板上，淡茶色短发被夜风吹拂，抬头望着满天繁星，侧过脸对你露出邻家青梅竹马般毫无防备的温柔微笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“每次坐在这里吹风，心情就会变得很平静呢……呐，宗介，今天也辛苦啦，过来坐我旁边吧。”
data.promptProse: Seated barefoot on the top stone step beneath the vermilion torii gate of her hillside shrine on a cool early summer night, Nozomi wears a pale-cream cotton camisole romper with a drawstring waist and daisy eyelet lace hem. Bracing both hands behind her on the smooth stone as the night breeze ruffles her bob, she turns with an open, heartwarming smile beneath a canopy of stars and distant town lights below. Warm amber firelight from a nearby stone lantern glows gently over her bare legs and profile.
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the top shrine stone steps beneath the vermilion torii gate in a pale-cream cotton camisole romper, Nozomi braces her hands behind her and turns with a warm, gentle smile. Stone lantern light glows softly beneath the starry sky and distant town lights.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a breathable pale-cream cotton camisole romper sleepsuit with a drawstring waist and delicate daisy eyelet lace trim, barefoot on the stone steps.
